ITEM 3 | Thin orange fragment, small and irregular, about 0.5 cm, sitting near the top edge of the cluster, dry-looking with no sheen | 1
ITEM 4 | Tiny pale yellow crumb or bit, about 0.3 cm, sitting at the lower right edge of the cluster on the plate, soft-looking with no sheen | 0.5
